scope: First-pass UI completed; later research packages prepared with explicit gates

work_packages.name: Verify existing A160 installation
work_packages.gate: No capacity promotion from image coverage, retrospective potential, additional candidates or the legacy municipal polygon
work_packages.next_action: Obtain an installation/as-built record from the owner, facilities team or MEP contractor. Any exploratory hypotheses require separately documented assumptions and remain outside default accounting.

work_packages.name: PVGIS hourly generation
expected_artifacts: import provenance and source timestamp report
work_packages.gate: Keep existing, counterfactual and incremental roles separate; preserve minute offsets; require UTC hourly validation. No production curve until an actual eligible series exists.
work_packages.implemented: Official seriescalc acquisition/cache, existing importer/temporal checks, manual fallback, UI sensitivity and sharing-ineligibility enforcement

work_packages.name: A160 and mixed-use physics/demand domain
required_inputs: A160 conditioned geometry, envelope, HVAC and operation evidence
representative year, weather and civil/standard/UTC calendar mapping
expected_artifacts: simulation manifest and aligned reference demands
whole-configuration holdouts and baseline comparisons before any surrogate expansion
work_packages.gate: Preserve the existing office model; reject unsupported geometry/area/typologies. No office-model scaling to the host or other uses. No meter labels without real meter evidence.

work_packages.name: Independent sharing comparison
required_inputs: same role-eligible PV and independent demand series across all strategies
inventory and exactly aligned hourly indices
work_packages.gate: Nonnegative normalized coefficients; demand and allocated-PV conservation; no extra import/emissions gain when host already consumes all PV; do not evaluate a plan on the forecast used to design it.

work_packages.name: Sourced impact screening
required_inputs: dated emissions factor and system boundary
work_packages.gate: No savings, payback or emissions result without sourced assumptions and evaluated balances. Redistribution is not generation or extra avoided emissions. 3D parcel design remains a separate task.
